prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: the top of pale stone city walls seen from above: large pale blocks with a walkway edge The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Create a square seamless tileable JRPG map ground texture: overhead top surfaces of pale stone city wall walkway, large worn pale limestone blocks and subtle walkway-edge courses integrated as repeating surface pattern. Top-down orthographic steep overhead, no perspective. Fill entire canvas edge-to-edge with stone surface only; no sky, sides of walls, borders, framing, objects, characters, text, or focal feature. Precisely match opposite edges in both axes for repeat tiling; stagger block joints in a periodic layout, with edge-crossing stones continuing seamlessly. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art. Coarse uniform square pixels, each visible art pixel approximately 7–8 display pixels wide, hand-placed clean pixel clusters 3–10 pixels wide. Hard crisp grid-aligned pixel edges exclusively; no AA, blur, soft brush, gradients, photographic texture, random noise, or checkerboard dithering. 4–6 earthy shades per material: warm yellow cream highlights, muted ivory and sandstone midtones, slightly saturated mauve/plum-red shadows in crevices and worn corners. Restrained varied cracks and edge wear, even distribution of detail. Calm even neutral overcast upper-left illumination, clean base colors, no cast shadows, no night darkness, lights, glow or vignette. Square texture.
